title: KIKIORI user guide
intro: KIKIORI is a workspace for organizing field knowledge through AI-assisted interviews. Choose a topic from the table of contents to get started.

sections.title: About KIKIORI
sections.summary: Combine AI interviews with human review to create knowledge that can be used with confidence.
steps: Configure the purpose and question fields for each knowledge area.
Review and edit information from the AI conversation before using it as knowledge.

sections.title: Choose a screen or knowledge area
sections.summary: Use the navigation on the left to choose the knowledge area and screen you need.
steps: Select a knowledge name to open its interview screen.
Switch between interviews, records, settings, and the knowledge list from navigation.
On a smartphone, open navigation from the menu button at the top of the screen.

sections.title: Start an interview
sections.summary: Prepare a knowledge area, create a record, and start an interview.
steps: Create a knowledge area and review its purpose, question fields, and interview settings.
Enter a record title on the interview screen and select the start button.
A record can be saved partway through and resumed later.

sections.title: Run an AI interview
sections.summary: Answer AI questions with text or voice.
steps: Read the conversation, enter an answer in the composer, and send it.
For a voice interview, select the voice start button and speak naturally.
As you answer, AI presents the next question or items that need review.

sections.title: Review knowledge
sections.summary: Review extracted information and items that still need confirmation.
steps: Use the knowledge panel on the interview screen to compare questions and answers.
Read each item waiting for confirmation and add or correct information when needed.
On a smartphone, open the panel with the knowledge button.

sections.title: Edit and confirm knowledge
sections.summary: Edit extracted content, review it, and save it after confirmation.
steps: Edit field names and descriptions in the knowledge settings.
Review records and extracted proposals, then approve or correct only the items that need action.
Save and confirm the content when it is ready to use as official knowledge.

sections.title: Review admin analysis
sections.summary: Administrators and knowledge managers can use the dashboard to review operations and priorities.
steps: Open the admin dashboard from the knowledge list and choose the date range or knowledge area.
Review knowledge, record, pending-review, and priority counts together with created, submitted, and approved trends.
Review the learning status counts for confirmed, pending, and follow-up items.
Select a knowledge area to generate learning analysis, then review its summaries and trends.
Review the reasons for priority records and open record details when follow-up is needed.

sections.title: Find knowledge
sections.summary: Use the knowledge list and tags to find the information you need.
steps: The knowledge list shows names, purpose, tags, and the last updated time.
Expand or collapse tag groups in navigation to find a knowledge area.

sections.title: Change the display language
sections.summary: Switch KIKIORI's display language from the user menu.
steps: Open the user area at the bottom of the sidebar and select Display language.
Choose 日本語, English, 简体中文, or ไทย to update the interface.

faq.question: How do I resume an interview?
faq.answer: Open the knowledge area and select a record from the interview list. Records in progress can be resumed from where you left off.

faq.question: Can I confirm AI-extracted content immediately?
faq.answer: Review the content before confirming it. Edit errors and save or confirm only after the item has been checked.

faq.question: How can I see where an action is on screen?
faq.answer: Open the user menu, select Start interactive guide, and choose the guide for your task.
